note.zh: 活动于西拉木伦河、老哈河流域，约前 300 年为燕将秦开所破；活动范围依史料示意，非国界。
note.en: Active around the Xar Moron and Laoha rivers; driven back by the Yan general Qin Kai around 300 BCE. The range is schematic, not a border.

extensions.source: 依《史记》《中国历史地图集》手绘示意

note.zh: 约前 4 世纪起见于记载，活动于阴山南北；赵武灵王、李牧皆与之交战。范围为示意，非国界。
note.en: Recorded from about the 4th century BCE, active north and south of the Yinshan; fought by King Wuling of Zhao and Li Mu. Schematic range, not a border.

extensions.source: 依《史记》《中国历史地图集》手绘示意

note.zh: 活动于今晋西北至河套以东，前 307 年前后为赵武灵王所破，后渐并入匈奴。范围为示意。
note.en: Active from northwestern Shanxi to east of the Ordos loop; broken by King Wuling of Zhao around 307 BCE and later absorbed by the Xiongnu. Schematic range.

extensions.source: 依《史记》《中国历史地图集》手绘示意

note.zh: 活动于今晋西北、陕北一带，赵武灵王北破林胡、楼烦，部分南迁。范围为示意。
note.en: Active in northwestern Shanxi and northern Shaanxi; defeated by King Wuling of Zhao, with part of the people resettled south. Schematic range.

extensions.source: 依《史记》《中国历史地图集》手绘示意

note.zh: 陇东戎人政权，前 272 年为秦所灭，秦因置陇西、北地、上郡。范围为示意。
note.en: A Rong polity in eastern Gansu, destroyed by Qin in 272 BCE after which Qin set up the Longxi, Beidi and Shangjun commanderies. Schematic range.
